top_signals.title: Fast-fashion retailer Shein’s 3-year IPO odyssey may have cost it the ‘golden time’ to go public
top_signals.summary: Investors are questioning whether Beijing's blessing can carry a $40-billion-plus valuation for a clothing retailer whose growth engine is stalling.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Coinbase shares slip after Q2 results despite prediction markets doubling and record trading market share
top_signals.summary: Coinbase said 88% of its net revenue now comes from sources other than bitcoin spot trading, as its share of global crypto volume grows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers for allegedly sharing patient information with third-party platforms
top_signals.summary: Popular telehealth provider Hims & Hers "shared consumers’ sensitive health information with third-party advertising platforms such as Meta and Snap despite promising to protect patient privacy," the federal government alleges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Behind the White House’s closed-door diplomacy
top_signals.summary: Media reports around the world have suggested the secrecy reflected Netanyahu's waning influence or growing dissatisfaction with him within the Trump administration.
